materials.name: Thermal Clad HPL-03015
materials.resin: High thermal performance dielectric for high power lighting
materials.notes: Insulated metal substrate for high power LED lighting, available on aluminium and copper substrates; the sheet does not list metal or copper thicknesses. Dielectric 0.0015 in (38 um), off-white. Product thermal conductivity 7.5 W/mK and dielectric thermal conductivity 3.0 W/mK; thermal resistance 0.02 C in2/W (0.13 C cm2/W); thermal impedance 0.30 C/W (TO-220 set-up); Tg 185 C (ASTM E1356, DSC). Maximum operating temperature 140 C (UL); maximum soldering 325 C for 60 s. Dk 6.6 (frequency not stated); Df 0.003 at 1 kHz and 0.005 at 1 MHz; capacitance 925 pF/in2; breakdown voltage 5.0 kV AC. CTI 0 PLC (600 V). The sheet gives one CTE for XY/Z: 35 um/m C below Tg and 85 above. Storage modulus 18 GPa at 25 C and 12 GPa at 150 C (stored value at 25 C). Volume and surface resistivity are printed as 1 with a superscript 14 (ohm m) and 13 (ohm/sq) and are not stored because the base of the exponent is not legible. Water vapor retention 0.11 %, total mass loss 0.15 %, collected volatile condensable material below 0.01 %.
